title: dep-scan config show output
description: The document `depscan config show --format json` writes on stdout: every effective scan option with the value the next scan receives and where the value came from. Values are printed verbatim, so a path-valued option shows the form the scan will read it in, not a rewritten one. Precedence when several sources set one option: the command line, then the checks or profile, then the depscan.toml file, then an environment variable, then the default. The exploitabilityRules object says where the rule table of the next scan comes from: the override a user named, or the table dep-scan ships.

options.description: One entry per internal option, named by its dest in the parsed namespace.

exploitability-rules.description: Where the exploitability rule table of the next scan comes from: the override file a user named through --exploitability-rules or depscan.toml, or the table dep-scan ships.

source.description: bundled when the scan grades with the table dep-scan ships; override when a user named a replacement file.

path.description: The override file's path as the scan will read it, or the bundled table's published location analysis_lib/data/exploitability_rules.yaml.

value.description: The value the next scan receives, verbatim.

source.description: Where the value came from, the highest-precedence source that set it.
